name: Meridian Pay A2A hop lab
description: Walk a delegated agent token chain one hop at a time: sign in, hand the job to a platform-signed external agent, exchange tokens (RFC 8693, third-party subject and actor), and call MCP tools through Privilege doors. Every hop shows sub/act/aud/scope, and refusals are demoed on purpose. Runs…
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 7720, loopback only; mock mode needs no settings). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:7720 only). Catalog id D110 (A2A delegation walkthrough).
